KNOWN TRAP CALLED OUT EXPLICITLY: an earlier incident found the checklistinsider layout can mint autograph sections as unsigned when a converter's category detection is wrong -- verified NOT the case here: every one of these 3,472 rows carries a category starting with 'auto-', none landed in the 'base' category this package stages, and this package excludes all of them rather than risk restaging any as unsigned.

categoriesExcludedAndWhy.decision: Excluded rows are NOT staged anywhere in this package and NOT discarded from the record -- they are fully reproducible from step 2's output via the command above, and a future pass can stage them as their own package once the insert/auto sub-keys are registered (R67 roster test applies per-insert, not done here).
